publications.title: Ayman M. Al-Sayari appointed FSB’s Regional Engagement Chair
publications.summary: In his role as FSB Regional Engagement Chair, Ayman M. Al-Sayari, Governor of the Saudi Central Bank (SAMA), will advise the FSB Chair and Plenary on how to enhance the Regional Consultative Groups’ contribution to the FSB’s work.
